explication: This is a static Chinese-font discovery and download catalog. Its principal workflow is browsing a categorized font listing, consulting each font’s descriptive and licensing metadata, and accessing font files; the README also documents the catalog’s authorization-focused curation and broad range of font styles. The sampled JavaScript shows a large metadata map and static preview/download paths, but does not show how the HTML pages consume that map, so those UI-to-data links are left unverified.
